abstract: A 68-year-old male presented to our hospital complaining of gross hematuria. Intravenous pyelography subsequently demonstrated a left non-visualized kidney, and he was admitted for further evaluation. Cystoscopy revealed a bladder tumor around the left ureteral orifice and retrograde pyelography showed a filling defect in the left renal pelvis. The urinary cytology from the left renal pelvis indicated class IV, and the microscopic findings of a bladder biopsy demonstrated grade 1 transitional cell carcinoma. We performed transurethral resection of bladder tumor (TUR-BT) followed by left nephroureterectomy with bladder cuff. The pathological diagnosis was high grade transitional cell carcinoma with choriocarcinomatous component. After the operation, the serum human chorionic gonadotropin-beta (hCG-beta) level was slightly elevated, and the combination chemotherapy with methotrexate, vinblastine and cisplatin (MVC) was administered. Although the serum hCG-beta level fell to 0.1 ng/ml, after two courses of MVC chemotherapy, bilateral pulmonary metastases appeared in the chest X-ray with increasing hCG-beta levels. Salvage chemotherapy with cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin (PEB) was performed. After two courses of PEB chemotherapy, the serum hCG-beta level fell to within the normal range and all pulmonary metastases disappeared.
abstract_ja: 68歳男性が肉眼的血尿を主訴に当院を受診した。静脈性腎盂造影で左腎が描出されず、精査のため入院となった。膀胱鏡検査では左尿管口周囲に膀胱腫瘍を認め、逆行性腎盂造影では左腎盂に充填欠損を認めた。左腎盂の尿細胞診はclass IVで、膀胱生検の顕微鏡所見はgrade 1の移行上皮癌であった。経尿道的膀胱腫瘍切除術(TUR-BT)に続き、膀胱カフを付けた左腎尿管全摘除術を施行した。病理診断は絨毛癌成分を伴う高異型度移行上皮癌であった。術後、血清β-hCG値がわずかに上昇したため、メトトレキサート、ビンブラスチン、シスプラチン(MVC)による併用化学療法を施行した。血清β-hCG値は0.1 ng/mlまで低下したが、MVC化学療法2コース後に両側肺転移が胸部X線で出現し、β-hCG値も上昇した。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン(PEB)による救援化学療法を施行した。PEB化学療法2コース後、血清β-hCG値は正常範囲内に低下し、肺転移はすべて消失した。
